name: Soil Moisture Dual-Probe Sensor
description: Like a thirsty plant alarm! Measures electrical conductivity between two soil probes.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a thirsty plant alarm! Measures electrical conductivity between two soil probes.
wiringGuidance: Connect probes to amplifier board. Connect amplifier VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and A0 (Yellow) to analog pin A0.
commonMistakes: Keeping power on 24/7 in moist soil, corroding copper probes rapidly through electrolysis.
Touching both prongs with sweaty skin during dry calibration.

miniExperiment.title: Soil Moisture Plant Monitor
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Outputs 0 in air, increasing to 600-800 when inserted into damp potting soil.
